name: 1-police-chase.png
description: Cover shot: a five-star Metro Police pursuit on Skyway Boulevard, low sun straight down the expressway. The player's muscle car is chased bumper-to-bumper by three marked interceptors with red and blue lightbars washing the asphalt, the tactical helicopter is deployed overhead with its amber searchlight beam and rotor wash on the deck, pedestrians scatter on the sidewalk, and the full tactical HUD is live: mission dossier panel, wanted stack with cash and health/armor/heat bars, a police response table listing every pursuing unit with its status and range, the weapon rack, the radar minimap with police blips, the radio ticker and the speedometer. The mission briefing panel is open at the bottom of the frame, showing the client's name, a generated low-poly portrait and the operation's dialogue.

name: 2-car-promenade.png
description: High-speed coastal cruise in a sports car along Ocean Promenade: open turquoise bay waters, the sun sinking on the horizon, swaying palm trees and a cypress grove, pedestrians along the promenade curb, Art Deco facades catching the last warm light, muzzle-ready cruiser far behind, and the full tactical HUD with the speedometer showing 151 MPH, the weapon rack, the radio ticker and the mission waypoint diamond on the radar minimap. The mission briefing panel is open at the bottom of the frame, showing the client's name, a generated low-poly portrait and the operation's dialogue.

name: 3-downtown-street.png
description: Downtown Avenue on foot at golden hour: Rhea 'Rook' Solano in the foreground on foot with a visible weapon, having just stepped out of an angled stolen sports car at the kerb; the sunlit avenue alive with moving traffic (taxi, sedan, oncoming hatchback), a double-parked delivery hauler and a kerbside muscle car; pedestrians walking in pairs along both sidewalks; a responding police cruiser with its lightbar on further down the street; and the tactical HUD complete with the mission dossier panel, the wanted stack, the police response table, the weapon rack, the radar minimap and the radio ticker. The mission briefing panel is open at the bottom of the frame, showing the client's name, a generated low-poly portrait and the operation's dialogue.
objective: DELIVER THE STOLEN VELOCE GT TO SAFEHOUSE (140M)

name: 4-dock-heist.png
description: Heist in progress at Meridian Cargo Docks Pier 7: the protagonist in the foreground visibly armed with a tactical carbine in a two-handed ready stance; mid-ground contraband crates on a pallet with a glowing golden objective beacon, the target heist hauler with its rear doors wide open, and armed dock guards closing in; the background shows the warehouse wall, colourful stacked shipping containers, the dockside jib crane and the 36 m gantry crane against the sunset sky; the tactical HUD shows the mission dossier, three wanted stars, the police response table, the weapon rack, the radar minimap and $75,000 in cash. The mission briefing panel is open at the bottom of the frame, showing the client's name, a generated low-poly portrait and the operation's dialogue.
objective: SEIZE THE CONTRABAND CRATES AT PIER 7 (10M)
